g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
7:- [Slack](https://docs.mcpjam.com/hosted/slack.md): Run MCPJam from Slack — mention the bot to ask about your projects, and appr
ove the actions that spend credits
38:- [My First ChatGPT App](https://docs.mcpjam.com/guides/first-chatgpt-app-react.md): Build a simple Coffee Shop ChatGPT App wit
h React
86:- [Pay for one local eval iteration](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/pay-for-one-local-eval-iteration.md): Coll
ect the declared prompt fee and reserve one iteration atomically before execution. Retries with the same identity reuse the receip
t; changed requests conflict. Uploads claim the payment without charging again.
125:- [Mint a model lease for MCPJam-hosted inference](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/eval-runs/mint-a-model-lease-for-mcpj
am-hosted-inference.md): How an SDK eval running OUTSIDE the platform (local dev, CI) uses MCPJam-hosted inference on the organiza
tion's credits, with no provider key of its own. Authenticate like any other `/api/v1` route (typically an `sk_` key).
151:- [Search or list unified sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/search-or-list-unified-sessions.md): The uni
fied, cross-surface sessions feed for one project: Playground, user-testing, eval, and swarm transcripts in one list, newest first
. Project-NESTED (unlike `/chat-sessions`) because `projectId` owns the scope here rather than filtering it.
154:- [Export project traces as OTLP/JSON](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/catalog/export-project-traces-as-otlpjson.md): Re
turns an OTLP `ExportTraceServiceRequest`. Pagination rides in RESPONSE HEADERS rather than the body so the payload stays a valid
OTLP document: read `x-mcpjam-next-cursor` and feed it back as `cursor`, and treat `x-mcpjam-export-complete: true` as the end of
the stream.
203:- [Request insights for an eval run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/evals/request-insights-for-an-eval-run.md): **No cr
edits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the finished run and draws on the same shared `insightsPerDa
y` request ledger as swarm and user-testing insights.
240:- [Session metrics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/session-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rates
over the study's sessions.
245:- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-win
dow.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model over the study's current window and draws on the
organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with eval-run and swarm run insights, so a request her
e takes one from there.
331:- [Send feedback to the MCPJam team](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/feedback/send-feedback-to-the-mcpjam-team.md): Tell
the MCPJam team about MCPJam itself (a bug, a missing capability, something confusing, or a docs gap) at the moment you hit it. T
HE TEXT IS SENT TO THE MCPJAM TEAM, outside your organization, and kept for 180 days. It is stored in MCPJam's own database and ne
ver published. Summarize: never incl…
